Its words are written here once, the title (the operator's descriptor of 1 Oct 2026) among them; scripts/build-readme-opening.mjs composes them into README.md with every other value read from the file it names: the two plugin lines from the README's own Install section, the Node.js major from package.json engines.node, the anchors from the README's own headings (the First run link among them), the report count from docs/data/stats.json, and the latest finding from the newest report's plain summary (docs/data/report-summaries.json). Spec 020 AC-30 and spec 126 read the README against this file. Never edit the README's opening by hand.
title: Driftproof (driftproofhq): open-source agent skill evaluation and regression testing across model releases
pitch: Driftproof measures whether an AI coding skill helps, seals each result in a dated receipt anyone can check, and measures the same tests again on each new model to show drift.
what: A skill is a `SKILL.md` file that teaches an AI coding agent how you like things done. Driftproof runs the skill's own tests with it and without it, and a model scores each answer several times. Each [receipt](https://driftproofhq.com/r/fad883d1018d3a4b3c75bc60b1eaec50032256cbf69fba3299999edf7978589c/) records the date, the model, the scores and the hashes of the skill and its tests, sealed by a sha256 of its own. `driftproof validate receipt.json` checks it against the [receipt schema](https://driftproofhq.com/spec/receipt.schema.json) and recomputes that hash: an edit made after sealing shows as `MISMATCH`. On a new model, run the same tests and `driftproof diff old.json new.json` compares the two receipts case by case, as [Report 008](https://driftproofhq.com/reports/008/) did from `claude-fable-5` to `claude-fable-5-1` with the same skill and test hashes.
limits: What it does not show: the hash is not a signature, so a receipt does not show who made or sealed it, or that a model ran. A result covers only the tests, model and judge its receipt names, and no clear difference is not proof of no effect.
try_heading: Try it in Claude Code, no API key
commands: `/driftproof:init` on a skill you already have drafts its test cases with you, adds them after you say yes, and makes a first receipt. `/driftproof:run` measures a skill in your repository and writes its receipt. It runs on your Claude Code subscription. You need Node.js {node_major} or later.
